summary.en: As Ran came home, she recieve a message from Momiji Ooka, asking Shinichi to solve some code from a deceased housekeeper of a wealthy family. Some hours ago, she also asked Heiji to solve the code, promising that he will do whatever she want if he solve the code faster than anyone. They later gather at Haido Chuo Building roof. Later they arrive at a pancake shop, where there is a huge line. When Momiji mention about add and subtract, Conan and Heiji solve the code. All the code has a sentence written "From your footbowl loving mother". The first three codes has the word "foot" in bold. The character for foot can also mean "add". Meanwhile, the last code has the word "bow" in bold. The character for bow can also mean "subtract". When all the codes are laid over each other, there is a sentence written Haido Harbor Warehouse 4. However, both of them solved the code simultaneously. They later followed the decoded message and headed to the said location What they found there was, a murder scene. The eldest son of the four brothers is found dead. Ran, Kazuha, and Momiji scream after seeing the body.
